oobe.step1Desc: Configure backend API URL and probe connectivity
oobe.step1LongDesc: First specify where the Rosetta FastAPI backend lives. The wizard will probe the /health endpoint and the OOBE status; once the probe succeeds, it automatically proceeds to system checks and dependency installation.
oobe.step1EmptyHint: Please complete the backend connection probe above first
oobe.connDesc: Tell the installer where to send all OOBE API requests during setup.
oobe.connLongDesc: Dev mode defaults to localhost port 8000. For production behind Nginx use the relative /api path. If frontend and backend are on different origins (port/domain), enter the full absolute URL.
oobe.connModeDevHint: Local dev with split stacks — FastAPI listens on 127.0.0.1:8000 by default
oobe.connModeProdHint: Behind a reverse proxy like Nginx, frontend reaches backend via same-origin /api
oobe.connApiUrlDevHint: e.g. http://127.0.0.1:8000/api. Entering just a port number auto-expands to localhost.
oobe.connApiUrlProdHint: Use /api for same-origin Nginx setups; enter https://domain.com/api for cross-origin.
oobe.connAppliedHint: Applied as the target backend for this wizard
oobe.connProbeOK: Probe OK: backend is reachable and healthy
oobe.connProbeOOBERequired: Backend is healthy — awaiting install (503 OOBE_REQUIRED)
oobe.connProbeNetworkError: Network unreachable / connection refused. Verify the backend is running on the given port and firewall rules allow it.
oobe.connProbeNotHealthy: /health did not return 'healthy'. The target may not be a Rosetta backend.
oobe.connProbeHintNext: You must pass the connection probe before advancing to the next step.
oobe.step2LongDesc: Set up the primary admin account for logging into the dashboard. You can add more users later from the admin panel.
oobe.step3LongDesc: Enter your site name, description, default language, SEO keywords, and the site URL. All of these can be changed later in the settings panel.
oobe.step4LongDesc: Review the summary below and click "Go to Admin" to finalize. The installer will run migrations, write the config, and seed default data — usually under a minute.
oobe.adminNameDesc: Letters, numbers and underscores only, 3-20 characters
oobe.adminPasswordPlaceholder: At least 8 chars with uppercase, lowercase and digits
oobe.siteDescriptionPlaceholder: A short one-liner about your blog
oobe.siteUrlDesc: Used for generating RSS links, OpenGraph cards, and email links
oobe.completeDesc: Please review the details below before starting. Do not close or refresh the page during installation.
oobe.sidebarHint1: Rosetta Setup Wizard · Out of the box
oobe.sidebarHint2: SQLite is used by default, no extra database service required
oobe.depInstallDesc: Auto-install uv / Node.js / pnpm and project dependencies (uv sync + pnpm install)
oobe.pgHint: Recommended for production — fill in the connection details below.
oobe.fCommentsDesc: Allow visitors to comment on posts.
oobe.fRegisterDesc: Allow visitors to self-register (off by default).
oobe.fBingDesc: Show Bing daily wallpaper as home background.
oobe.fCryptoDesc: Publish posts protected by a password.
oobe.fMusicDesc: Show a music player in the sidebar (configure sources in the admin panel).
oobe.installingDesc: Initializing database, writing config, seeding sample data — please wait.
oobe.readyDesc: Click the button below — the system will initialize the database, write configuration and seed sample data. Expect about 10 to 30 seconds.
oobe.depPartFail: Some dependencies failed. Please check the logs or install them manually.
oobe.tlsDesc: Your current production configuration will submit the admin password over unencrypted HTTP. Any attacker on the same network can sniff the credentials.
oobe.tlsGoBack: Go back and switch to HTTPS
oobe.tlsContinueAnyway: I understand the risks, continue anyway
oobe.tlsHintTlsTerminate: Recommended: cancel this installation now and re-run after enabling TLS on your reverse proxy.
oobe.tlsHintConfigureReverseProxy: Best practice: obtain a free Let's Encrypt certificate via Nginx / Caddy / Traefik and change both your API and site URLs to https://.
oobe.tlsHintRisk: Proceeding will send your admin password, login tokens and cookies in plaintext over the public internet — a critical account-theft risk.
oobe.installSnapshotPolling: Verifying installation state via snapshot API…
oobe.installSnapshotTimeoutDetail: No progress events were received for 30 seconds (the SSE channel may have been dropped by network or proxy). The system is now reconciling the true installation state via snapshot — your progress is not lost.
oobe.installSnapshotPollingDetail: Snapshot polling: querying backend install status every 5 seconds, up to 3 times. If the backend actually completed, we will automatically advance to the success screen.
oobe.connApiUrlEmptyHint: Please enter the backend API URL, e.g. http://127.0.0.1:8000/api or /api
oobe.connApiUrlInvalidHint: Invalid URL format. Only absolute http(s)://host:port[/api] or same-origin relative /api is supported
oobe.connApiUrlWillNormalizeHint: After probing, this will be normalized to: {url}

oobe.errPasswordShort: Password must be at least 8 characters

about.title: About
about.desc: About the author behind this site, the tech stack, and everything.
about.bioP1: Hi, I'm the maintainer behind Rosetta. I write product code by day, hack on open-source projects by night, and wander around with a camera on weekends. This blog is where I keep engineering notes, reading notes, and bits of life — a simple place for thoughts to leave footprints.
about.bioP2: My focus is mainly on Web frontend architecture, developer experience, and toolchains that just feel good to use. Minimalism is my taste — I seek balance through restraint, both in code and in design.
about.bioP3: If anything here resonates with you, feel free to drop a note in the guestbook, or reach out via email or social links below. Link exchanges are always welcome — let's keep the indie web woven together.
about.motto: Stay hungry, stay foolish. Write code, write life.

about.buyMeCoffeeDesc: If any article or code here helped you, consider supporting me through the links below. A like, comment, or share is already the best coffee I could ask for.
